    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

    times = list(map(int, data[2:]))

    current_time = 0
    count = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if current_time + (i + 1) <= times[i] and current_time + (i + 1) < T:
            current_time += (i + 1)
            count += 1
        elif current_time + (i + 1) >= T:
            break

    print(count)
